duration_rationale: Fixed seven-day pilot captures weekday/weekend and multiple daily cycles. This is not a power guarantee or proof of inter-regime stability. No extension based on PnL.

confidence.method: circular moving-block bootstrap over calendar-hour net PnL and closed-entry counts; all empty hours retained; ratio sum(pnl)/sum(closed entries); zero-denominator replicate makes evidence inconclusive
confidence.sensitivity_requirement: same strictly positive lower bound; insufficient blocks => INCONCLUSIVE

new_thresholds: 100 entries / 50 markets / eight 6h blocks / 99% coverage are prospective screening requirements, not historical calibrated thresholds. DD20% inherited from D4 risk screening, explicitly applied prospectively, not a claim of V1 validation.
failure_rule: Integrity, unknown fees, residuals or insufficient sample => INCONCLUSIVE and stop. With complete evidence, any economic or risk criterion false => FAIL and stop. Never open next split unless PASS.
partition_capital: 500 independently for each split; no per-market reset; purged boundary markets produce no entries; all residual positions must resolve before release of next split
